chunks: Ahmad ibn Harun al-Fami (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far ibn Jami' al-Himyari narrated to us from his father, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Aban al-Ahmar, from Sa'd al-Kinani, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, from Abdullah ibn Abbas. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him): O Ali! You are my vicegerent over my nation in my lifetime and after my death. You are to me as Sheeth was to Adam, as Sam was to Nuh, as Isma'il was to Ibrahim, as Yusha' was to Musa, and as Sham'un was to Isa.

O Ali! You are my executor, my inheritor, and the one who will wash my body; you are the one who will bury me in my grave, fulfill my debts, and carry out my promises. O Ali! You are the Commander of the Faithful, the Imam of the Muslims, the leader of those with radiant marks, and the chief of the God-fearing. O Ali! You are the husband of the Mistress of Women, Fatima my daughter, and the father of my two grandsons al-Hasan and al-Husayn.

O Ali! Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has placed the descendants of every prophet in his own loins, but He has placed my descendants in your loins. O Ali! Whoever loves you and aligns with you, I love him and align with him; whoever hates you and opposes you, I hate him and oppose him — for you are from me and I am from you. O Ali! Allah has purified us and chosen us; none of our forebears from the time of Adam have ever met in an illicit union. So none will love us except one whose birth was pure. O Ali! Rejoice at martyrdom, for you will be oppressed and killed after me. So Ali (peace be upon him) said: O Messenger of Allah! Will that be while my religion is safe? He said: While your religion is safe. O Ali! You will never go astray and never slip. Were it not for you, the party of Allah would not be known after me.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful — the highest title of authority conferred by the Prophet on Ali
key_terms.الْغُرُّ الْمُحَجَّلُونَ: Those with radiant marks (on faces and limbs) — believers whose acts of worship will illuminate them on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.حِزْبُ اللَّه: The party of Allah — those aligned with divine guidance and the rightful Imam
key_terms.خَلِيفَة: Vicegerent/successor — specifically the divinely appointed successor over the Prophet's community
key_terms.سَيِّدَةُ النِّسَاء: Mistress/Lady of Women — Fatima's title acknowledging her highest rank among all women
key_terms.سِبْط: Grandson (specifically from a daughter) — refers to al-Hasan and al-Husayn as the Prophet's grandsons
key_terms.سِفَاح: Illicit union/adultery — negated here to establish the pure lineage of the Prophet and Ali
key_terms.وَصِيّ: Executor/legatee — the designated trustee appointed to carry out the Prophet's will and responsibilities
key_terms.يَعْسُوب: Chief/leader — literally the queen bee, used as a title for the head of a community

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Imam Ali about his status as vicegerent and successor?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated by Abdullah ibn Abbas and transmitted through a chain of respected Shia narrators, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addresses Imam Ali (AS) directly and comprehensively establishes his unique spiritual and political status. The Prophet declares Ali as his vicegerent (khalifa) over the entire Muslim community both during his lifetime and after his death, comparing him to the specially chosen successors of previous prophets — Sheeth (successor of Adam), Sam (successor of Nuh), Isma'il (successor of Ibrahim), Yusha' (successor of Musa), and Sham'un (Simeon, disciple of Isa). He further affirms Ali's roles as executor, inheritor, the one to wash and bury the Prophet's body, the fulfiller of his debts and promises, Commander of the Faithful, Imam of the Muslims, and keeper of his prophetic legacy through the line of Fatima al-Zahra and the Imams al-Hasan and al-Husayn. The hadith culminates with the Prophet's prophecy of Ali's martyrdom and the assurance that his religion will be intact, ending with the remarkable statement that without Ali, the party of Allah (hizb Allah) would be unrecognizable after the Prophet's passing.
word_analysis: and were it not for you

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Harun al-Fami (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far b. Jami` al-Himyari narrated to us from his father from Ayyub b. Nuh from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Aban al-Ahmar from Sa`d al-Kinani from al-Asbagh b. Nubata from `Abdullah b. `Abbas. He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said to `Ali (as): O `Ali! You are my vicegerent (khalifa) over my Nation in my lifetime and after my death. You are to me as Sheeth was to Adam, and as Sam was to Nuh, and as Isma`il was to Ibrahim, and as Yusha` was to Musa, and as Sham`un was to `Isa.

O `Ali! you are my deputy, my inheritor, the one who will wash my body, the one who will bury me in my grave, the one who will represent my religion, and the one who will fulfill my traditions. O `Ali! You are the Commander of the Faithful, the Imam of the Muslims, the Leader of the shining believers, and the Chief of the Godfearing. O `Ali! You are the husband of the Mistress of Women, my daughter Fatima; you are the father of my two descendants al-Hasan and al-Husayn.

O `Ali! Allah put the descendants of every prophet in his loins, and He put my descendants in your loins. O `Ali! Whoever loves you and aligns with you, I have loved him, and I have aligned with him, and whoever hates you and opposes you, I have hated him and opposed him; for you are from me and I am from you. O `Ali! Allah has purified us and chosen us, O `Ali! None of our ancestors from the descendants of Adam have ever committed adultery. So, none will love us except he whose birth was pure. O `Ali! Be gladdened by martyrdom, for you will be persecuted and killed after me. So, `Ali (as) said: O Messenger of Allah! Will I be at peace with my religion? He said: You will be at peace with your religion, `Ali. Surely, you cannot be misguided, and you cannot falter. Had it not been for you, the party of Allah would not be known after me.
